entities.name: Jindra Kramperová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jindra "Jindřiška" Kramperová was a Czech figure skater and pianist. A three-time national champion in ladies' singles, she represented Czechoslovakia at the 1956 Winter Olympics and she was fifth at the European Championships (1958).
